title: Who Is the Best IPL Captain of All Time? Dhoni vs Rohit and Every Title Winner (2008-2026)
seoTitle: Best IPL Captain of All Time: Dhoni vs Rohit (2026)
seoDescription: Dhoni and Rohit Sharma share the record with 5 IPL titles each. Every title-winning captain from 2008 to 2026, Patidar's RCB double and who ranks best.
excerpt: MS Dhoni and Rohit Sharma have won five IPL titles each as captain, and Rajat Patidar led RCB to back-to-back titles in 2025 and 2026. Here is every title-winning captain from 2008 to 2026, Dhoni vs Rohit compared, and the current captains.
